title: Case-study graph sizes
description: Complete source graphs; vertex and edge counts are not samples.

title: Case-study densities
description: Density uses the simple undirected convention, not the bipartite fill denominator.

title: Degree distributions
description: Complete distributions are shown rather than only their means.

title: Local clustering distributions
description: A bipartite graph has no triangles; zero clustering does not imply an absence of event structure.

title: Numerical verification coverage
description: Counts come from executed assertions; a passing test is not a usability result.

title: A worked structural network plot
description: Seven vertices, six edges, one triangle, three bridges and one isolate.

description: The same grammar and percentile definitions are used for every graph.

title: Node-link baseline: Karate club
description: Complete graph; a 100-iteration force-directed layout uses a fixed seed.

title: Adjacency-matrix baseline: Karate club
description: Ordering uses the same inferred partition as the summary, not external labels.

title: Node-link baseline: Les Miserables
description: Complete graph; a 100-iteration force-directed layout uses a fixed seed.

title: Adjacency-matrix baseline: Les Miserables
description: Ordering uses the same inferred partition as the summary, not external labels.

title: Triangles and bridges
description: Zero bars are absent on the logarithmic axis and remain explicit in the descriptor table.

title: Weighted versus unweighted degree
description: Weights represent interaction contexts and are not interpreted as distances.

title: Bipartite projection changes density
description: Pairwise ties through shared events do not give an equivalent rendering of the original two-mode graph.

title: Direction loss in the neural archive
description: Directed strong connectivity and undirected connectivity are different quantities; the summary is computed only after projection.

title: Partition stability across random starts
description: Each distribution contains 190 dependent pairwise agreements from 20 starts.

title: Community-resolution sensitivity
description: Error bars are standard deviations across five optimisation seeds, not confidence intervals.

title: Clustering across controlled families
description: Each family contributes 36 graphs; size and seed are retained for blocked evaluation.

title: Principal-component projection
description: This full-ensemble unsupervised projection is descriptive, not a held-out predictive result.

title: Feature ablation with size holdout
description: All models use the same splits; imputation is fitted on training graphs only.

title: Out-of-size confusion matrix
description: Each of 180 graphs is predicted once by a model trained on the other two sizes.

title: Held-out feature importance
description: Correlated descriptors may substitute for one another; this is not a causal mechanism ranking.

title: Label-permutation chance control
description: Thirty-nine permutations give a minimum attainable plus-one p-value of 0.025; the diagnostic is exploratory.

title: Distances from empirical signatures to generator centres
description: Synthetic scales define the metric; nearest centres do not identify empirical generating processes.

title: Small-world rewiring response
description: All graphs have 300 vertices and 1,200 edges; error bars are between-seed standard deviations.

title: Planted-community recovery
description: Agreement uses the known block assignment, not a truth inferred from modularity.

title: Modularity under increasing mixing
description: Modularity and recovery answer different questions; a high score alone does not establish a true partition.

title: LFR recovery and generation availability
description: Every attempt is retained; failed generations are not replaced with a different family.

title: Signature drift under edge deletion
description: Twelve deletion replicates per setting on one fixed graph; bars are standard deviations, not population uncertainty.

title: Bottleneck sensitivity to missing edges
description: The denominator is remaining edges; both bridge counts and fractions are retained in the table.

title: Sampling error in betweenness
description: Fifteen source samples per setting; the full-source calculation is compared with exact computation.

title: Degree-preserving rewiring
description: Every degree sequence is checked for equality; closure and modularity remain free to change.

title: Non-uniqueness in the graph atlas
description: The tested keys are numerical marginal summaries, not the complete visual grammar; the result exposes one information-loss mechanism.

title: Descriptor-extraction scaling
description: Median and range across five sparse preferential-attachment graphs per size; 32 betweenness source samples.

title: Memory scaling
description: The dense line is calculated storage, not a measured matrix run. Tracemalloc excludes some native allocations.

title: End-to-end baseline timings
description: Construction and rendering at the same canvas size; three graphs per size, without a perceptual outcome.

title: Representation mark complexity
description: Counts exclude axes, text and raster pixels. Twelve community blocks and one residual block bound the strip.

title: Uncertainty in generator discrimination
description: The bootstrap resamples twelve seed clusters; it does not quantify transfer to real networks.
